description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Strict' that extends the 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_XHTMLAndHTML4' class. It customizes HTML purification behavior by setting the name, default level, and defining specific fixes and child definitions related to strict HTML blockquote content.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Strict
classes.description: A specialized HTML module class for strict Tidy HTML processing, extending functionality from a parent class to enforce strict blockquote content rules.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to add a specific fix for 'blockquote#content_model_type', setting it to 'strictblockquote'.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Returns a specialized child definition for 'strictblockquote' content model types, otherwise defers to the parent class implementation.
